meta.description: Convert a grover_base checkpoint (encoder-only or encoder + vocab heads) into a hybrid checkpoint by adding a randomly-initialized cMIM decoder + latent_dist, then continue pretraining on the user's corpus as hybrid (vocab + contrast). Effectively kermt-continue-pretrain with a one-time ckpt-conversion step prepended.

key_strengths: Exceptional safety design with hard rule never to modify input checkpoint and all outputs to isolated timestamped run directories
Comprehensive validation at multiple stages (check_checkpoint, check_data, prepare_data) preventing invalid workflows
Clear experimental status disclosure with validation recommendations before production use
Well-documented error scenarios with specific redirection guidance to related skills (kermt-continue-pretrain, kermt-pretrain-scratch)
Strong composability via kermt-container.sh wrapper and clear integration with broader KERMT ecosystem

recommendations.title: Add checkpoint quality validation guidance after upgrade
recommendations.problem: Experimental status warns about validating downstream performance but no intermediate checks documented for upgraded checkpoint before multi-day pretraining
recommendations.root_cause: Workflow assumes upgrade always produces valid hybrid checkpoint; no smoke-test recommended
recommendations.fix: Add Step 6.5 after upgrade: 'Recommended: test the upgraded checkpoint with a short pretrain run (--epochs 1 on small subset) to validate hybrid architecture before launching full multi-day pretraining. Check run.json confirms model_type: hybrid and both vocab + contrastive losses present in logs.'

recommendations.title: Document recovery path for finetuned-checkpoint-only scenario
recommendations.problem: Workflow rejects finetuned checkpoints but provides no guidance for users who only have post-finetune checkpoint and lost original pretrain version
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes users maintain pretrain checkpoint provenance
recommendations.fix: Add to Common errors section for task_ffn=true rejection: 'If original pretrain checkpoint is unavailable, consider: (1) re-pretraining from scratch with kermt-pretrain-scratch, or (2) advanced: manually strip task_ffn layers from finetuned checkpoint (not officially supported; validate carefully).'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for repeated upgrades
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running upgrade multiple times with same inputs is safe or produces identical results
recommendations.root_cause: Timestamped run directories prevent overwrites but determinism not documented
recommendations.fix: Add to Hard rules: 'Repeated upgrades: running this workflow multiple times on the same input checkpoint and corpus creates independent timestamped run directories. Each upgrade initializes the cMIM decoder randomly, so upgraded checkpoints from separate runs will differ even with same inputs.'

recommendations.title: Add examples.md reference file for common patterns
recommendations.problem: 181-line SKILL.md is efficient but could benefit from concrete examples for common use cases (encoder-only upgrade, encoder+vocab upgrade, legacy GROVER conversion)
recommendations.root_cause: Single-file design trades examples for brevity
recommendations.fix: Create references/examples.md with 3 concrete examples: (1) upgrading encoder-only checkpoint, (2) upgrading encoder+vocab checkpoint, (3) handling legacy GROVER with architecture drift. Reference from When to invoke section.
